AccountDeletionReceipt.title: AccountDeletionReceipt
AccountDeletionReceipt.description: The result of an account deletion: the account is gone and agents are revoked.

AddItemRequest.title: AddItemRequest
AddItemRequest.description: Append one item to a section; the server mints the item id.

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description: One audit-log row, projected for the feed and item-history reads.

AuthenticatedUser.title: AuthenticatedUser
AuthenticatedUser.description:
The authenticated user's own view, returned by register/login/refresh/me.

Carries the private ``email`` (the caller is the account owner) but never the
password hash.

AuthorizationContext.title: AuthorizationContext
AuthorizationContext.description: What the SPA consent screen renders for a parked ``auth_request_id``.

BulletpointRecord.title: BulletpointRecord
BulletpointRecord.description: A canonical bulletpoint with its resolved provenance edges and usage count.

BulletpointWrite.title: BulletpointWrite
BulletpointWrite.description: The create/update body: required text plus the full provenance-edge lists.

ClientRegistrationRequest.title: ClientRegistrationRequest
ClientRegistrationRequest.description: RFC 7591 registration input. Only ``redirect_uris`` is required at P0.

ClientRegistrationResponse.title: ClientRegistrationResponse
ClientRegistrationResponse.description: RFC 7591 registration response echoing the stored client metadata.

ConnectedClient.title: ConnectedClient
ConnectedClient.description: One authorized agent in the user's connected-clients list.

DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest
DecisionRequest.description: The human's consent decision for a parked request.

DecisionResult.title: DecisionResult
DecisionResult.description:
The loopback URL the SPA redirects the browser to (approve or deny).

Returned as JSON (not a 302) because the SPA calls the decision endpoint via a
credentialed XHR; the SPA performs the browser navigation to the loopback
listener itself.

DeletionReceipt.title: DeletionReceipt
DeletionReceipt.description: The result of a permanent delete: what was removed, and whether a vector went with it.

DuplicateSource.title: DuplicateSource
DuplicateSource.description: Make a faithful copy of an existing resume.

ExportResult.title: ExportResult
ExportResult.description: Where a persisted resume PDF lives, plus a time-limited URL to download it.

FromResumeSource.title: FromResumeSource
FromResumeSource.description: Seed content from an existing resume (the copies may later diverge in shape).

IdentitySnapshot.title: IdentitySnapshot
IdentitySnapshot.description: Inlined, frozen identity facts a finalized resume carries in place of a reference.

IdentitySnapshotContact.title: IdentitySnapshotContact
IdentitySnapshotContact.description: Frozen contact facts inlined on finalize; each field optional per variant.

IdentitySnapshotLink.title: IdentitySnapshotLink
IdentitySnapshotLink.description: A labeled link inlined on finalize.

IdentityVariantRead.title: IdentityVariantRead
IdentityVariantRead.description: A variant with its default flag and archive state.

IdentityVariantWrite.title: IdentityVariantWrite
IdentityVariantWrite.description: The create/update body: label, name, optional contact, links, default flag.

LibraryRefItem.title: LibraryRefItem
LibraryRefItem.description: An item that references a canonical bulletpoint; the text is resolved on read.

LibraryRefItemInput.title: LibraryRefItemInput
LibraryRefItemInput.description: Add an item that references a canonical bulletpoint.

LocalItem.title: LocalItem
LocalItem.description:
A resume-local item: a copy-on-write fork or a net-new inline item.

Its ``text`` lives only here, so it is never searchable and never embedded.
``forked_from_bullet_id`` is set when the item is a fork of a canonical bullet
(the copy-on-write path sets it); a net-new inline item leaves it unset.

LocalItemInput.title: LocalItemInput
LocalItemInput.description: Add a net-new inline item; its text lives only on the resume.

LocalItemSourceRefs.title: LocalItemSourceRefs
LocalItemSourceRefs.description: Provenance carried on a local item so it can later be promoted to the library.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Login input. ``email`` is a plain string (not ``EmailStr``) so a malformed
address takes the same generic 401 path as a wrong password, never leaking
whether the address is even well-formed vs. registered.

PreviewRequest.title: PreviewRequest
PreviewRequest.description: A preview render, optionally with a template override (not persisted).

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
Registration input. ``email`` is validated as an address; the password's
strength is enforced in the service for a specific, field-level message.

ReorderRequest.title: ReorderRequest
ReorderRequest.description: A section reorder: the full ordered id list for one kind.

ResumeCreateRequest.title: ResumeCreateRequest
ResumeCreateRequest.description: The creation contract: ``kind`` sets the result; ``source`` seeds the content.

ResumeHeader.title: ResumeHeader
ResumeHeader.description: The header: a living resume references a variant; a finalized one inlines a snapshot.

ResumeKind.title: ResumeKind
ResumeKind.description: A resume is either an evergreen living resume or a single application resume.

ResumeRecord.title: ResumeRecord
ResumeRecord.description: A single resume with its full, validated (upcast-on-read) document.

ResumeReorderRequest.title: ResumeReorderRequest
ResumeReorderRequest.description:
Reorder sections and/or the items within sections, addressed by id.

``section_order`` is the full ordered list of section ids; each entry of
``item_orders`` maps a section id to the full ordered list of its item ids.
Both are permutations of their current sets (the service rejects a partial or
duplicated list), so a reorder never addresses an item by array index and never
collides. At least one of the two must be provided.

ResumeSection.title: ResumeSection
ResumeSection.description: One ordered section: an id-keyed items map plus an explicit order list.

ResumeStatus.title: ResumeStatus
ResumeStatus.description: Living resumes stay ``draft``; an application resume freezes to ``finalized``.

ResumeSummary.title: ResumeSummary
ResumeSummary.description: List projection: the scalar columns without the document.

ResumeUpdate.title: ResumeUpdate
ResumeUpdate.description: The full-document write: the authoritative content the single writer persists.

SectionKind.title: SectionKind
SectionKind.description: The fixed set of resume section kinds.

SkillRead.title: SkillRead
SkillRead.description: A skill with its derived usage count (computed from tag matches, not stored).

SkillReorderRequest.title: SkillReorderRequest
SkillReorderRequest.description: A reorder: the full ordered id list for the user's active skills.

SkillWrite.title: SkillWrite
SkillWrite.description: The create/rename body: a skill is defined by its curated ``name``.

SourceKind.title: SourceKind
SourceKind.description: The four ground-truth source kinds; the ``sources.kind`` discriminator.

SourceRecord.title: SourceRecord
SourceRecord.description: A single source with its typed subtype detail joined in.

SourceSummary.title: SourceSummary
SourceSummary.description: Common-column projection for section lists (no subtype join).

TagRead.title: TagRead
TagRead.description: A tag for the reuse list; color is derived from the label, not carried.

TemplateInfo.title: TemplateInfo
TemplateInfo.description: A template registry entry the selector lists.

VariantContact.title: VariantContact
VariantContact.description: A variant's contact fields; each is optional (a variant may omit any).

VariantLink.title: VariantLink
VariantLink.description: A labeled link (e.g. a portfolio or profile URL).

WorklogRecord.title: WorklogRecord
WorklogRecord.description: A single entry, adding the bulletpoints that frame it (provenance).

WorklogSummary.title: WorklogSummary
WorklogSummary.description: A worklog entry with its tags and attached sources (the timeline row).

WorklogWrite.title: WorklogWrite
WorklogWrite.description: The create/update body: required title + date; optional description, tags, sources.
